description: §14.8.9 S441 fix round (F2) — a REVERSIBLE ENCODING of the protected column (a character-code round trip through `Array.from` + `String.fromCharCode`) is not a derived flow. Provenance is preserved by default through any call the compiler does not know to be a one-way deriver: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: MEASURED on the first S441 cut (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar, security review F2): the analysis treated any unmodelled callee given a scalar as "derived", so this — and `Buffer.from(h).toString("base64")`, `new URL("…?h=" + h).search`, `new Error(h).message` — served the hash. §14.8.9 (S441 amendment): "The derived-flow exemption is an explicit ALLOWLIST, not 'any callee the module does not define'"; charCodeAt is lossless and is not on it.
